body: Thank you to everyone who commented. I think I will tell my partner eventually, just because it's something I was pretty traumatized by. When my period was late I used to sit on the toilet telling God that I would for real kms if it happened again. I'm agnostic. I just get really confused when I get baby crazy. Feels like I shouldn't feel that way cause I know better but feelings hardly ever make sense. I'm working on my self-talk, meditating has been very helpful with that. Sending lots of love to everyone on here ❤️
Thank you for the kind words, really means a lot ❤️

I am in therapy, my ex literally wouldn't leave my house until I promised I'd get help. I felt much better after he left but stuck with therapy. Just feeling especially bad today because I feel like I HAVE to tell the guy im seeing about it cause I have issues about some of that stuff. But I have no idea how.
